title: 荷蘭三角洲工程
summary: 本課以荷蘭三角洲工程為入口，深入區域防洪網路、環境取捨與分期調適決策。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
summaryEn: Using Delta Works as its entry point, this course examines regional flood-defence networks, environmental tradeoffs and staged adaptation. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitleEn: Tidal barriers, navigation and dam construction

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設年超越機率p=0.001且各年獨立平穩，50年內至少一次為1−(1−p)⁵⁰=0.04879，約4.879%；非荷蘭現行標準。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設三個必須全成功的區段年失效機率各0.001且獨立，系統失效1−0.999³=0.002997；不是把機率相乘成10⁻⁹。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 風險敏感度保留50年期限與各年獨立、平穩假設，只將年超越機率p由0.001改為0.002。由100[1−(1−p)⁵⁰]計算，累積機率由4.8794%增為9.5253%，並非精確翻倍。此比較說明非線性的期間換算，不假定氣候、暴露或防護性能在真實未來50年必然不變。
workedExample.textEn: This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual exceedance p=0.001 with independent stationary years. At least one event in fifty years has probability 1−(1−p)⁵⁰=0.04879, or 4.879 percent, not a Dutch standard. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume three essential segments each fail annually with probability 0.001 independently. System failure is 1−0.999³=0.002997, not the product 10⁻⁹. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. Retain the fifty-year horizon and independent stationary years, changing only annual exceedance probability p from 0.001 to 0.002. The relation 100[1−(1−p)⁵⁰] changes cumulative probability from 4.8794% to 9.5253%, not exactly double. This illustrates nonlinear horizon conversion without asserting that climate, exposure or protection performance will actually remain stationary for fifty years.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「重現期與壽命風險」與「串聯防線薄弱節點」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Return period and lifetime risk" and "Weak links along a defence line": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 重現期與壽命風險：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Return period and lifetime risk: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「重現期與壽命風險」如何影響荷蘭三角洲工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Return period and lifetime risk” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Delta Works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 年度超越機率描述每年的事件風險，不代表兩次洪水必須相隔固定年數。跨年累積需說明平穩與獨立假設，氣候及暴露變化可能使它們失效。 假設年超越機率p=0.001且各年獨立平穩，50年內至少一次為1−(1−p)⁵⁰=0.04879，約4.879%；非荷蘭現行標準。 重現期不是保固年限，同一年也可能出現多次高水事件。若把歷史氣候外推成固定未來機率，會讓長壽命設施的累積風險看似比實際更確定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「重現期與壽命風險」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Annual exceedance probability does not impose a fixed interval between floods. Multi-year accumulation requires stationary and independent years, assumptions that climate and exposure changes can invalidate. Assume annual exceedance p=0.001 with independent stationary years. At least one event in fifty years has probability 1−(1−p)⁵⁰=0.04879, or 4.879 percent, not a Dutch standard. Return period is not a warranty, and several high-water events can occur within one year. Treating historical climate as fixed future probability makes lifetime risk appear more certain than the evidence supports. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Return period and lifetime risk” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設年超越機率p=0.001且各年獨立平穩，50年內至少一次為1−(1−p)⁵⁰=0.04879，約4.879%；非荷蘭現行標準。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual exceedance p=0.001 with independent stationary years.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「千年重現期代表一次洪水後至少一千年不會再發生。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A thousand-year return period prevents another flood for at least one thousand years." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「重現期與壽命風險」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Return period and lifetime risk”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 重現期與壽命風險
knowledge.text: 年度超越機率描述每年的事件風險，不代表兩次洪水必須相隔固定年數。跨年累積需說明平穩與獨立假設，氣候及暴露變化可能使它們失效。
knowledge.textEn: Annual exceedance probability does not impose a fixed interval between floods. Multi-year accumulation requires stationary and independent years, assumptions that climate and exposure changes can invalidate.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：千年重現期代表一次洪水後至少一千年不會再發生。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A thousand-year return period prevents another flood for at least one thousand years. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「重現期與壽命風險」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Return period and lifetime risk" is correct?
options: 千年重現期代表一次洪水後至少一千年不會再發生。
年度超越機率描述每年的事件風險，不代表兩次洪水必須相隔固定年數。
同一保護圈的多段堤防可以當成完全平行備援。
optionsEn: A thousand-year return period prevents another flood for at least one thousand years.
Annual exceedance probability does not impose a fixed interval between floods.
Several segments of one protection ring act as fully parallel backups.
quiz.explanation: 年度超越機率描述每年的事件風險，不代表兩次洪水必須相隔固定年數。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Annual exceedance probability does not impose a fixed interval between floods. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 重現期與壽命風險：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Return period and lifetime risk: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「重現期與壽命風險」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Return period and lifetime risk” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設年超越機率p=0.001且各年獨立平穩，50年內至少一次為1−(1−p)⁵⁰=0.04879，約4.879%；非荷蘭現行標準。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual exceedance p=0.001 with independent stationary years. At least one event in fifty years has probability 1−(1−p)⁵⁰=0.04879, or 4.879 percent, not a Dutch standard. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將事件定義和記錄年份寫清楚，核對統計是否把超越荷載與結構失效混淆；對變動年機率改用逐年生存機率乘積，再比較平穩近似偏差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Define events and observation years, checking whether load exceedance is confused with structural failure.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設年超越機率p=0.001且各年獨立平穩，50年內至少一次為1−(1−p)⁵⁰=0.04879，約4.879%；非荷蘭現行標準。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual exceedance p=0.001 with independent stationary years. At least one event in fifty years has probability 1−(1−p)⁵⁰=0.04879, or 4.879 percent, not a Dutch standard.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「重現期與壽命風險」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Return period and lifetime risk", which statement holds?
options: 保留相同潮灘面積就一定保留相同生態功能。
只需關閉歷時乘船數就能精確得到全部經濟損失。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設年超越機率p=0.001且各年獨立平穩，50年內至少一次為1−(1−p)⁵⁰=0.04879，約4.879%。
optionsEn: Preserving equal tidal-flat area necessarily preserves identical ecological function.
Closure duration times vessel count precisely gives all economic losses.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual exceedance p=0.001 with independent stationary years.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設年超越機率p=0.001且各年獨立平穩，50年內至少一次為1−(1−p)⁵⁰=0.04879，約4.879%；非荷蘭現行標準。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual exceedance p=0.001 with independent stationary years. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 重現期與壽命風險：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Return period and lifetime risk: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「重現期與壽命風險」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Return period and lifetime risk” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將事件定義和記錄年份寫清楚，核對統計是否把超越荷載與結構失效混淆；對變動年機率改用逐年生存機率乘積，再比較平穩近似偏差。另外說明年度超越事件和災損事件並非同義。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Define events and observation years, checking whether load exceedance is confused with structural failure. For changing probabilities use the product of annual survival probabilities and compare the stationary approximation. Explain separately why annual load exceedance and a damaging failure are not equivalent events. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以重現期與壽命風險編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。將事件定義和記錄年份寫清楚，核對統計是否把超越荷載與結構失效混淆；對變動年機率改用逐年生存機率乘積，再比較平穩近似偏差。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for return period and lifetime risk, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Define events and observation years, checking whether load exceedance is confused with structural failure. For changing probabilities use the product of annual survival probabilities and compare the stationary approximation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：重現期不是保固年限，同一年也可能出現多次高水事件。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Return period is not a warranty, and several high-water events can occur within one year. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將事件定義和記錄年份寫清楚，核對統計是否把超越荷載與結構失效混淆；對變動年機率改用逐年生存機率乘積，再比較平穩近似偏差。另外說明年度超越事件和災損事件並非同義。
knowledge.textEn: Define events and observation years, checking whether load exceedance is confused with structural failure. For changing probabilities use the product of annual survival probabilities and compare the stationary approximation. Explain separately why annual load exceedance and a damaging failure are not equivalent events.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以重現期與壽命風險編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。將事件定義和記錄年份寫清楚，核對統計是否把超越荷載與結構失效混淆；對變動年機率改用逐年生存機率乘積，再比較平穩近似偏差。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for return period and lifetime risk, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Define events and observation years, checking whether load exceedance is confused with structural failure. For changing probabilities use the product of annual survival probabilities and compare the stationary approximation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「重現期與壽命風險」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Return period and lifetime risk"?
options: 將事件定義和記錄年份寫清楚，核對統計是否把超越荷載與結構失效混淆；對變動年機率改用逐年生存機率乘積，再比較平穩近似偏差。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
地圖上所有低窪面積都能立即提供相同蓄洪能力。
optionsEn: Define events and observation years, checking whether load exceedance is confused with structural failure.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
All low ground on a map immediately provides equal usable flood storage.
quiz.explanation: 將事件定義和記錄年份寫清楚，核對統計是否把超越荷載與結構失效混淆；對變動年機率改用逐年生存機率乘積，再比較平穩近似偏差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Define events and observation years, checking whether load exceedance is confused with structural failure. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 重現期與壽命風險：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Return period and lifetime risk: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「重現期與壽命風險」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Return period and lifetime risk” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 重現期不是保固年限，同一年也可能出現多次高水事件。若把歷史氣候外推成固定未來機率，會讓長壽命設施的累積風險看似比實際更確定。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Return period is not a warranty, and several high-water events can occur within one year. Treating historical climate as fixed future probability makes lifetime risk appear more certain than the evidence supports. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若把歷史氣候外推成固定未來機率，會讓長壽命設施的累積風險看似比實際更確定。

knowledge.title: 暴潮共同原因相關
knowledge.text: 不同屏障可能同時遭遇同一風場與海水位，聯合失效不一定等於各機率乘積。相關性須來自共同機制與資料，而不是為簡化計算而任意設定。
knowledge.textEn: Different barriers can face the same wind and sea level, so joint failure need not equal the product of individual probabilities. Dependence should come from shared mechanisms and evidence rather than computational convenience.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩座屏障距離遠就能直接假設風暴失效互相獨立。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Widely separated barriers can automatically be assumed independent under storm loading. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「暴潮共同原因相關」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Common storm dependence" is correct?
options: 不同屏障可能同時遭遇同一風場與海水位，聯合失效不一定等於各機率乘積。
兩座屏障距離遠就能直接假設風暴失效互相獨立。
保留相同潮灘面積就一定保留相同生態功能。
optionsEn: Different barriers can face the same wind and sea level, so joint failure need not equal the product of individual probabilities.
Widely separated barriers can automatically be assumed independent under storm loading.
Preserving equal tidal-flat area necessarily preserves identical ecological function.
quiz.explanation: 不同屏障可能同時遭遇同一風場與海水位，聯合失效不一定等於各機率乘積。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Different barriers can face the same wind and sea level, so joint failure need not equal the product of individual probabilities. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Common storm dependence” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設P(A)=0.02、P(B|A)=0.4，聯合P(A∩B)=0.008；若誤用P(B)=0.02獨立相乘，只得0.0004，相差20倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume P(A)=0.02 and P(B|A)=0.4. Joint probability is 0.008; incorrectly using independent P(B)=0.02 gives 0.0004, twenty times smaller. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把共同風暴、供電和預報錯誤列成可追溯事件類別，核對兩站事件是否同時；比較條件與無條件機率的樣本量，報告稀少資料造成的區間。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Protection and tidal-flat area” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Delta Works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 海口改變會影響潮差和潮灘濕潤頻率，防洪效益不能只以封閉長度評價。簡化斜坡幾何可連結水位變化與棲地面積，但真實地形需要測量。 假設平直潮灘長10 km、橫坡1:1000、水位帶縮小0.2 m，水平寬度差200 m，面積差2 km²；純幾何，不預測生態品質。 面積相同的棲地可能有不同淹水時長、粒徑和食物供應，不能直接當作等值生態補償。地形隨侵蝕淤積改變時，固定坡度模型也會逐年偏離。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「防洪與潮灘面積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Inlet modification changes tidal range and intertidal wetting frequency, so protection benefits cannot be judged only by closure length. A simple slope connects level change to habitat area, while real terrain requires surveys. Assume straight tidal flat length 10 km, cross-slope 1:1000 and tidal-band reduction 0.2 m. Width changes 200 m and area 2 km², a geometric estimate rather than ecological quality. Equal habitat area can differ in inundation duration, grain size and food supply, preventing automatic ecological equivalence. Erosion and deposition also progressively invalidate a fixed-slope geometric model. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Protection and tidal-flat area” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume straight tidal flat length 10 km, cross-slope 1:1000 and tidal-band reduction 0.2 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「保留相同潮灘面積就一定保留相同生態功能。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

Inconsistent survey footprints can create fictitious volume gains or losses between years. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Coastal sediment budget” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Coupled outer defence and storage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Delta Works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 外海屏障降低暴潮進入，卻可能限制內河排水，內部蓄洪空間因此成為系統的一部分。把堤防與蓄水設施各自最佳化可能產生相互衝突。 假設外閘關閉4 h、內河淨入流500 m³/s，需暫存7.2 million m³；若允許平均升水0.3 m，理想有效面積24 km²。 名義庫容若被堤路隔開或入口狹窄，可能在洪峰前無法充分使用。把所有低地直接相加作可用面積，會低估局部最高水位和淹水轉移。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「內外防線蓄洪耦合」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An outer barrier excludes surge but can restrict river drainage, making inland storage part of the defence system. Optimizing embankments and storage independently may create conflicting requirements. Assume outer closure four hours with net river inflow 500 m³/s, requiring storage 7.2 million m³. At allowed mean rise 0.3 m, ideal effective area is 24 km². Nominal storage separated by roads or narrow entrances may not fill before the peak. Adding all low ground as usable area understates local maximum levels and the redistribution of flooding. steps.instruction: 分期調適需要在功能不足前啟動設計施工，監測門檻因此必須包含實施提前量。看到水位達極限才開始準備，可能已錯過調整窗口。 假設剩餘功能裕度0.4 m、情境增加速率0.01 m/year，達限40 years；若實施需15 years，最晚應於25 years前啟動，限線性情境。 海平面加速或施工延期會縮短可用時間，單一速率估算不能當精確倒數。若監測指標與實際失效模式沒有關聯，提早量再長也可能觸發錯誤措施。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「調適門檻與提前量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
